summary: Withdrawing an apartment proposal prompts {board} to withdraw a companion hotel proposal.
realLife: New York City's 2025 hotel order explicitly recorded withdrawal of its April proposal after the apartment and loft proposal from the same day was withdrawn.
gates: The case record identifies the two proposal dates and separate withdrawal decisions.
inGame: needs: two proposal dates and separate withdrawal decisions.

turns.what: Each docket needs a replacement proposal.
The other docket retains its own status.
